blocks.zh: Section IV.A: Device QS Provisions (21 CFR 4.4(b)(1)) | 器材品質系統規定
blocks.en: Section IV.A: Device QS Provisions (21 CFR 4.4(b)(1))

blocks.zh: 器材品質系統規定（藥品CGMP基礎簡化途徑附加要求）
blocks.en: Device Quality System Provisions (Additional Requirements under the Streamlined Drug CGMP-Based Approach)

blocks.zh: 本節內容 — Section IV.A Contents
blocks.en: Section IV.A Contents

blocks.zh: Context 背景 820.20 Management Responsibility 820.30 Design Controls 820.50 Purchasing Controls 820.100 CAPA 820.170 & 820.200 Installation & Servicing QMSR Update 2026
blocks.en: Context 820.20 Management Responsibility 820.30 Design Controls 820.50 Purchasing Controls 820.100 CAPA 820.170 & 820.200 Installation & Servicing QMSR Update 2026

blocks.zh: 學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解「藥品CGMP基礎簡化途徑」下，需額外附加的六項器材QS規定是哪些，以及為何選擇這六項。
blocks.en: Understand which six additional device QS requirements apply under the streamlined drug CGMP-based approach, and why these six were chosen.

blocks.zh: 掌握 820.20 管理責任要求，以及與藥品CGMP現有要求的差異與銜接。
blocks.en: Grasp the 820.20 management responsibility requirements, and how they differ from and connect to existing drug CGMP requirements.

blocks.zh: 深入理解 820.30 設計管控——這是對藥廠衝擊最大的全新要求，學會DHF、設計輸入/輸出、驗證/確效的完整脈絡。
blocks.en: Understand 820.30 design controls in depth. This is the new requirement with the greatest impact on drug manufacturers; learn the full chain of the DHF, design input/output, and verification/validation.

blocks.zh: 理解 820.50 採購管控對供應商資格及器材零件進廠管制的具體要求。
blocks.en: Understand what 820.50 purchasing controls require for supplier qualification and for the receipt and control of device components.

blocks.zh: 掌握 820.100 CAPA 的閉環結構，以及與藥品偏差/OOS調查系統的整合方式。
blocks.en: Grasp the closed-loop structure of 820.100 CAPA and how to integrate it with the drug deviation/OOS investigation system.

blocks.zh: 判斷 820.170（安裝）與 820.200（服務）是否適用於你的組合產品。
blocks.en: Determine whether 820.170 (installation) and 820.200 (servicing) apply to your combination product.

blocks.zh: 了解 QMSR（ISO 13485 調和版，2026年生效）對這六項要求的影響。
blocks.en: Understand how the QMSR (the ISO 13485-harmonized rule, effective 2026) affects these six requirements.

blocks.zh: 背景解讀：為何是這六項？
blocks.en: Background: Why These Six?

blocks.zh: 兩條路徑的邏輯
blocks.en: The Logic of the Two Pathways

blocks.zh: 21 CFR Part 4 對組合產品提供兩種CGMP遵循途徑：
blocks.en: 21 CFR Part 4 offers two CGMP compliance pathways for combination products:

blocks.zh: 藥品CGMP基礎途徑（4.4(b)(1)）：以 21 CFR Part 210/211 為主體，附加這六項器材QS規定。這是藥廠 / CDMO 的自然路徑。
blocks.en: Drug CGMP-based approach (4.4(b)(1)): built on 21 CFR Parts 210/211, with these six device QS provisions added. This is the natural pathway for drug manufacturers and CDMOs.

blocks.zh: 器材QS基礎途徑（4.4(b)(2)）：以 21 CFR Part 820 為主體，附加藥品CGMP特定要求。這是器材廠的路徑。
blocks.en: Device QS-based approach (4.4(b)(2)): built on 21 CFR Part 820, with specific drug CGMP requirements added. This is the pathway for device manufacturers.

blocks.zh: 本節討論的是前者——藥品CDMO最常走的路。
blocks.en: This section covers the former, the route most drug CDMOs take.

blocks.zh: 比喻：母語加選修
blocks.en: Analogy: Native Language Plus Electives

blocks.zh: 想像你的公司已熟悉藥品CGMP，它是你的「母語」。加入組合產品後，你不需要改說器材QS的「外語」，但需要學會六個關鍵「器材詞彙」：820.20、820.30、820.50、820.100、820.170、820.200。
blocks.en: Imagine your company is already fluent in drug CGMP, your "native language". When you take on a combination product, you do not have to switch to speaking the "foreign language" of device QS, but you do need to learn six key "device words": 820.20, 820.30, 820.50, 820.100, 820.170 and 820.200.

blocks.zh: FDA 選擇這六項，是因為它們補足了藥品CGMP在設計管控、供應鏈、閉環CAPA、管理承諾等面向的系統性缺口。
blocks.en: FDA chose these six because they fill systemic gaps in drug CGMP in areas such as design controls, the supply chain, closed-loop CAPA and management commitment.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務重點
blocks.en: Practical Points for CDMOs

blocks.zh: 對於以無菌充填為主業的藥品CDMO，這六項的實務影響由高到低排列如下：
blocks.en: For a drug CDMO focused on sterile filling, the practical impact of these six, from highest to lowest, is as follows:

blocks.zh: 820.30 設計管控 — 全新概念，衝擊最大
blocks.en: 820.30 Design Controls: a completely new concept with the greatest impact

blocks.zh: 820.100 CAPA — 需將偏差系統升級為閉環結構
blocks.en: 820.100 CAPA: the deviation system must be upgraded to a closed-loop structure

blocks.zh: 820.20 管理責任 — 正式化管理審查
blocks.en: 820.20 Management Responsibility: management review must be formalized

blocks.zh: 820.50 採購管控 — 擴展供應商資格範圍
blocks.en: 820.50 Purchasing Controls: the scope of supplier qualification must be expanded

blocks.zh: 820.170 / 820.200 — 多數無菌充填CDMO不適用
blocks.en: 820.170 / 820.200: not applicable to most sterile filling CDMOs

blocks.zh: 820.20 管理責任 — 解讀與應用
blocks.en: 820.20 Management Responsibility: Interpretation and Application

blocks.zh: 核心概念：管理責任的法定化
blocks.en: Core Concept: Management Responsibility Made a Legal Requirement

blocks.zh: 藥品CGMP（21 CFR 211.22）雖然要求設置品質管制部門，但對「高階管理層的具體義務」描述較模糊。820.20 則明確規定：
blocks.en: Drug CGMP (21 CFR 211.22) requires a quality control unit, but is rather vague about the "specific obligations of senior management". 820.20 is explicit:

blocks.zh: 品質政策（Quality Policy）：由最高管理層親自制定，不可委託
blocks.en: Quality Policy: established by top management personally; it cannot be delegated

blocks.zh: 管理代表（Management Representative）：指定一名管理層成員負責QMS，並向高層報告績效
blocks.en: Management Representative: a member of management appointed to be responsible for the QMS and to report its performance to top management

blocks.zh: 管理審查（Management Review）：定期、有紀錄的正式審查，是法定義務而非選項
blocks.en: Management Review: a formal, documented review conducted at defined intervals; it is a legal obligation, not an option

blocks.zh: 品質計畫（Quality Plan）：針對特定組合產品的資源與活動規劃
blocks.en: Quality Plan: planning of the resources and activities for a specific combination product

blocks.zh: 比喻：從「默契管理」到「契約管理」
blocks.en: Analogy: From "Tacit Understanding" to "Contractual Management"

blocks.zh: 在純藥品工廠，管理層對品質的承諾往往是文化性的——大家「懂」高層重視品質，但未必白紙黑字。820.20 要求把這份承諾寫成正式法律義務：管理審查要有日期、有議程、有結論、有後續行動紀錄。
blocks.en: In a pure drug plant, management commitment to quality is often cultural: everyone "knows" that senior management values quality, but it may not be written down. 820.20 requires this commitment to be written as a formal legal obligation: management reviews must have a date, an agenda, conclusions, and a record of follow-up actions.

blocks.zh: 就像公司治理從「家族默契」升級為「董事會議事規範」。
blocks.en: It is like corporate governance moving from "family understanding" to formal "board meeting procedures".

blocks.zh: 藥廠與CGMP的差距分析
blocks.en: Gap Analysis for Drug Manufacturers

blocks.zh: 藥廠現有的品質管制單位（21 CFR 211.22）通常已具備：品質政策、SOP體系、品質審查機制。
blocks.en: A drug manufacturer's existing quality control unit (21 CFR 211.22) typically already has: a quality policy, an SOP system, and quality review mechanisms.

blocks.zh: 典型缺口：
blocks.en: Typical gaps:

blocks.zh: 管理審查未正式化（無固定頻率、無會議紀錄）
blocks.en: Management review is not formalized (no fixed frequency, no meeting minutes)

blocks.zh: 未明確指定「管理代表」角色及其職責
blocks.en: No clearly designated "Management Representative" role and responsibilities

blocks.zh: 品質計畫（Quality Plan）未針對組合產品制定
blocks.en: No Quality Plan prepared for the combination product

blocks.zh: 建議做法：在既有 QMS 中增加組合產品專屬的 Quality Plan 附錄，並設立每季度管理審查機制。
blocks.en: Recommended approach: add a combination product-specific Quality Plan appendix to the existing QMS, and establish a quarterly management review.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務場景
blocks.en: CDMO Practical Scenario

blocks.zh: 假設你的無菌充填CDMO接受一個 PFS（預填充注射器）組合產品委託案。820.20 要求你必須：
blocks.en: Suppose your sterile filling CDMO accepts a project for a PFS (prefilled syringe) combination product. 820.20 requires you to:

blocks.zh: 為此產品制定組合產品專屬的 Quality Plan
blocks.en: Prepare a combination product-specific Quality Plan for this product

blocks.zh: 指定管理代表（可以是現有 QA Director）並正式記錄其職責
blocks.en: Appoint a Management Representative (this can be an existing QA Director) and formally document their responsibilities

blocks.zh: 在每次管理審查中納入此組合產品的品質指標（如OOS率、CAPA完成率、設計變更記錄）
blocks.en: Include this combination product's quality indicators (such as OOS rate, CAPA completion rate and design change records) in every management review

blocks.zh: 確保合約製造設施的品質資訊可被你的管理審查取得
blocks.en: Ensure that quality information from contract manufacturing facilities is available to your management review

blocks.zh: 思考練習
blocks.en: Thinking Exercise

blocks.zh: 你的CDMO目前每年進行一次管理審查，會議記錄僅留存議程。要符合 820.20(c) 的要求，你需要在管理審查中增加哪些內容？審查頻率是否足夠？
blocks.en: Your CDMO currently holds one management review a year, and the minutes retain only the agenda. To meet 820.20(c), what do you need to add to the management review? Is the review frequency sufficient?

blocks.zh: 820.30 設計管控 — 藥廠最陌生的要求
blocks.en: 820.30 Design Controls: The Requirement Least Familiar to Drug Manufacturers

blocks.zh: 為何這是最大衝擊？
blocks.en: Why Is This the Biggest Impact?

blocks.zh: 純藥品工廠從不需要「設計管控」，因為藥物配方開發走的是 ICH Q8 製藥開發的框架，重點在化學穩定性、製程工藝，而不是「硬體設計」。
blocks.en: A pure drug plant has never needed "design controls", because drug formulation development follows the ICH Q8 pharmaceutical development framework, which focuses on chemical stability and process engineering rather than "hardware design".

blocks.zh: 但當你製造含有器材組成元件的組合產品（如 PFS、自動注射器、吸入器），那個「器材」部分是有物理設計的，FDA 要求你對它執行完整的設計管控週期。
blocks.en: But when you manufacture a combination product with a device constituent part (such as a PFS, autoinjector or inhaler), that device part has a physical design, and FDA requires you to run the full design control cycle for it.

blocks.zh: 比喻：建築師 vs. 廚師
blocks.en: Analogy: Architect vs. Chef

blocks.zh: 藥品開發像廚師：你試驗配方，找到對的比例，然後把食譜寫下來（批次記錄）。你的關注點是「成品好不好吃」（藥效、安全性）。
blocks.en: Drug development is like a chef: you try out recipes, find the right proportions, then write the recipe down (the batch record). Your focus is whether "the finished dish tastes good" (efficacy, safety).

blocks.zh: 器材設計管控像建築師：你先定義用戶需求（設計輸入），畫出藍圖（設計輸出），確認藍圖符合需求（驗證），蓋完後確認使用者真的能住進去（確效），並把整個設計演變過程建檔（DHF）。
blocks.en: Device design control is like an architect: you first define user needs (design input), draw the blueprint (design output), confirm the blueprint meets the needs (verification), confirm after construction that people can really live in the building (validation), and file the entire design evolution (DHF).

blocks.zh: 組合產品需要你同時扮演廚師和建築師。
blocks.en: A combination product requires you to play both chef and architect at the same time.

blocks.zh: 關鍵時間點：Phase 2 之前就要開始
blocks.en: Key Timing: Start Before Phase 2

blocks.zh: FDA 指引明確：設計驗證（Verification）和部分確效活動（如人因工程測試）應在臨床試驗啟動前完成。
blocks.en: FDA guidance is explicit: design verification and some validation activities (such as human factors testing) should be completed before clinical trials begin.

blocks.zh: 實務意義：設計管控文件體系必須在早期開發階段就建立，而不是上市前才補。很多藥廠的錯誤在於：把設計管控當作「上市前的行政整理工作」，但 FDA 要求的是從可行性評估開始就有紀錄。
blocks.en: In practice: the design control documentation system must be established in early development, not added just before marketing. A common mistake among drug manufacturers is treating design controls as "pre-launch administrative tidying", whereas FDA expects records from the feasibility assessment onward.

blocks.zh: DHF vs. DMR vs. DHR — 三個縮寫的區別
blocks.en: DHF vs. DMR vs. DHR: Three Acronyms Compared

blocks.zh: DHF（Design History File）：記錄「如何設計出這個產品」的所有過程文件
blocks.en: DHF (Design History File): all the documents recording "how this product was designed"

blocks.zh: DMR（Device Master Record）：記錄「如何製造這個產品」的所有現行規格文件
blocks.en: DMR (Device Master Record): all the current specification documents recording "how this product is manufactured"

blocks.zh: DHR（Device History Record）：記錄「每批產品如何被製造出來」的生產記錄
blocks.en: DHR (Device History Record): the production records showing "how each batch of product was manufactured"

blocks.zh: 類比到藥品世界：DHF ≈ 開發報告；DMR ≈ Master Batch Record；DHR ≈ Batch Record。
blocks.en: Drug-world equivalents: DHF ≈ development report; DMR ≈ Master Batch Record; DHR ≈ Batch Record.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務場景：現有藥品升級為組合產品
blocks.en: CDMO Practical Scenario: Upgrading an Existing Drug to a Combination Product

blocks.zh: 你的客戶原本委託你灌裝一個已上市的單株抗體（mAb），現在要改用 PFS 自動注射器組合銷售。
blocks.en: Your client originally contracted you to fill a marketed monoclonal antibody (mAb), and now wants to market it as a PFS autoinjector combination.

blocks.zh: 設計管控的起點是「評估 PFS 器材可行性」的那一刻，而不是申請 BLA supplement 的時候。你需要：
blocks.en: The starting point of design controls is the moment you begin "assessing the feasibility of the PFS device", not when the BLA supplement is filed. You need to:

blocks.zh: 以既有藥品規格（配方、劑量、給藥途徑）作為設計輸入的基礎
blocks.en: Use the existing drug specifications (formulation, dose, route of administration) as the basis of the design inputs

blocks.zh: 評估 PFS 材質（矽化劑、橡膠柱塞）對藥品穩定性的影響 → 這是組合產品的新設計輸入
blocks.en: Assess the impact of PFS materials (silicone lubricant, rubber plunger) on drug stability; this is a new design input for the combination product

blocks.zh: 建立 DHF，收納所有相容性測試、人因工程研究、臨床橋接數據
blocks.en: Establish a DHF that holds all compatibility testing, human factors studies and clinical bridging data

blocks.zh: 即使藥品本身無需重新設計，器材-藥品介面的設計管控仍是必要的
blocks.en: Even if the drug itself does not need redesign, design controls for the device-drug interface are still required

blocks.zh: QTPP / CQA 如何對應設計管控？
blocks.en: How Do QTPP / CQA Map to Design Controls?

blocks.zh: FDA 指引認可這個橋接：藥廠熟悉的 QTPP（目標品質概況）和 CQA（關鍵品質屬性）概念，可以作為組合產品設計輸入的藥品端基礎。
blocks.en: FDA guidance recognizes this bridge: the QTPP (quality target product profile) and CQA (critical quality attribute) concepts familiar to drug manufacturers can serve as the drug-side basis for combination product design inputs.

blocks.zh: 例如：CQA「注射劑量精確性 ±5%」可以直接轉化為 PFS 器材端的設計輸入規格。這讓藥廠可以用熟悉的語言切入設計管控框架。
blocks.en: For example, the CQA "injection dose accuracy ±5%" can be translated directly into a design input specification for the PFS device. This lets drug manufacturers enter the design control framework in familiar language.

blocks.zh: 一個藥廠將一個已在 vial 劑型上市的 mAb，改為 autoinjector 組合產品。請判斷：哪些 DHF 文件必須新建？哪些可以從既有開發報告中引用？什麼情況下需要進行額外的設計驗證？
blocks.en: A drug manufacturer is converting a mAb already marketed as a vial presentation into an autoinjector combination product. Determine: which DHF documents must be newly created? Which can be referenced from the existing development reports? Under what circumstances is additional design verification needed?

blocks.zh: 820.50 採購管控 — 超越 211.84 的器材面向
blocks.en: 820.50 Purchasing Controls: The Device Dimension Beyond 211.84

blocks.zh: 820.50 vs. 211.84 — 兩套系統的互補關係
blocks.en: 820.50 vs. 211.84: Two Complementary Systems

blocks.zh: 藥品CGMP下，21 CFR 211.84 已要求對藥品組成成分（原料、容器、封口件）進行取樣、測試、驗收。那為何還需要 820.50？
blocks.en: Under drug CGMP, 21 CFR 211.84 already requires sampling, testing and approval of drug components (raw materials, containers, closures). So why is 820.50 still needed?

blocks.zh: 211.84：聚焦在藥品端的進廠檢驗（化學、微生物測試）
blocks.en: 211.84: focuses on incoming inspection of the drug side (chemical and microbiological testing)

blocks.zh: 820.50：聚焦在整個供應鏈的風險評估與管控，包括器材零組件供應商的資格審核與持續監控
blocks.en: 820.50: focuses on risk assessment and control across the whole supply chain, including qualification and ongoing monitoring of device component suppliers

blocks.zh: 關鍵：即使你已有 211.84 的進廠檢驗程序，針對器材組成元件的供應商管控部分仍需依據 820.50 的架構進行補強。
blocks.en: Key point: even if you already have 211.84 incoming inspection procedures, supplier controls for device constituent parts must still be reinforced under the 820.50 framework.

blocks.zh: 820.50 供應商管控的三個層次
blocks.en: Three Levels of 820.50 Supplier Control

blocks.zh:
層次一：供應商評估
基於風險（供應品的關鍵性、規格複雜度）決定審核深度：書面審計 → 問卷 → 現場稽核
blocks.en:
Level 1: Supplier evaluation
The depth of evaluation is set on a risk basis (criticality of the supplied item, complexity of the specification): document audit → questionnaire → on-site audit

blocks.zh:
層次二：核可供應商清單（ASL）
建立並維護正式的 Approved Supplier List，記錄評估結論與核可條件
blocks.en:
Level 2: Approved Supplier List (ASL)
Establish and maintain a formal Approved Supplier List that records the evaluation conclusions and approval conditions

blocks.zh:
層次三：採購合約條款
合約中明訂供應商須主動通知材料/製程變更（Change Notification Clause）
blocks.en:
Level 3: Purchasing agreement terms
The agreement must require the supplier to notify you proactively of material or process changes (Change Notification Clause)

blocks.zh: 變更通知條款 — 為何至關重要？
blocks.en: Change Notification Clauses: Why Are They So Important?

blocks.zh: 組合產品的挑戰在於：器材零件供應商自行更改其材料（如 PFS 玻璃管壁厚度、橡膠柱塞配方），可能直接影響藥品穩定性，但他們未必主動告知你。
blocks.en: The challenge for combination products is that device component suppliers may change their own materials (such as the wall thickness of a PFS glass barrel or the formulation of a rubber plunger), which can directly affect drug stability, yet they may not tell you proactively.

blocks.zh: FDA 明確建議：在採購合約中加入供應商變更通知義務條款，一旦供應商的製程或材料有異動，必須提前告知，讓你能執行補充的設計驗證測試。
blocks.en: FDA expressly recommends including a supplier change notification obligation in purchasing agreements: when the supplier's process or materials change, they must notify you in advance so that you can perform supplementary design verification testing.

blocks.zh: 這個條款同時服務於 820.50（採購管控）和 820.30（設計管控），是組合產品供應鏈管理的核心工具。
blocks.en: This clause serves both 820.50 (purchasing controls) and 820.30 (design controls), and is a core tool of combination product supply chain management.

blocks.zh: 比喻：汽車零件 vs. 藥瓶
blocks.en: Analogy: Car Parts vs. Drug Vials

blocks.zh: 買普通藥品原料，像買食材——你只要確認品質規格符合即可。但買 PFS 自動注射器的器材零件，像買汽車零件——你不只要確認零件規格，還要確認供應商的製程穩定性、品管能力、變更管理程序，因為零件的製程改變可能影響整個系統的安全性。
blocks.en: Buying ordinary drug raw materials is like buying groceries: you only need to confirm that the quality specifications are met. Buying device components for a PFS autoinjector is like buying car parts: you must confirm not only the part specifications but also the supplier's process stability, quality control capability and change management procedures, because a process change in a part can affect the safety of the whole system.

blocks.zh: 你的CDMO為一個 PFS 組合產品進行充填。供應鏈涉及：
blocks.en: Your CDMO is filling a PFS combination product. The supply chain involves:

blocks.zh: 玻璃管供應商（器材零件）
blocks.en: Glass barrel supplier (device component)

blocks.zh: 橡膠柱塞供應商（器材零件，與藥品直接接觸）
blocks.en: Rubber plunger supplier (device component, in direct contact with the drug)

blocks.zh: 外包滅菌服務（ETO或gamma滅菌廠）
blocks.en: Outsourced sterilization service (ETO or gamma sterilization facility)

blocks.zh: 820.50 要求你必須對上述三類供應商都進行正式的資格審核，並在採購合約中加入變更通知條款。即使這些供應商在你的 211.84 程序中已被覆蓋，器材端的風險評估面向仍需補齊。
blocks.en: 820.50 requires formal qualification of all three types of supplier, with change notification clauses in the purchasing agreements. Even if these suppliers are already covered by your 211.84 procedures, the device-side risk assessment must still be completed.

blocks.zh: 你的CDMO目前有完整的 211.84 進廠檢驗程序和供應商資格系統。請列舉三項在轉型為組合產品製造商後，需要針對 820.50 進行補充的具體差距。
blocks.en: Your CDMO currently has complete 211.84 incoming inspection procedures and a supplier qualification system. List three specific gaps that must be filled for 820.50 after you become a combination product manufacturer.

blocks.zh: 820.100 CAPA — 閉環品質管理的核心
blocks.en: 820.100 CAPA: The Core of Closed-Loop Quality Management

blocks.zh: 什麼是「閉環CAPA」？
blocks.en: What Is "Closed-Loop CAPA"?

blocks.zh: 藥品CGMP（21 CFR 211.192）要求偏差調查，但重點在找出原因。820.100 更進一步，要求建立完整的閉環系統：
blocks.en: Drug CGMP (21 CFR 211.192) requires deviation investigations, but the emphasis is on finding the cause. 820.100 goes further and requires a complete closed-loop system:

blocks.zh: 識別（Identify）：系統化收集品質數據，識別問題或潛在問題
blocks.en: Identify: systematically collect quality data and identify problems or potential problems

blocks.zh: 調查（Investigate）：確定根本原因（Root Cause Analysis）
blocks.en: Investigate: determine the root cause (Root Cause Analysis)

blocks.zh: 糾正行動（Corrective Action）：消除已發生問題的原因
blocks.en: Corrective Action: eliminate the cause of a problem that has occurred

blocks.zh: 預防行動（Preventive Action）：消除潛在問題的原因，防止首次發生
blocks.en: Preventive Action: eliminate the cause of a potential problem, preventing first occurrence

blocks.zh: 驗證有效性（Verify Effectiveness）：確認CAPA真正解決了問題
blocks.en: Verify Effectiveness: confirm that the CAPA actually solved the problem

blocks.zh: 傳遞資訊（Disseminate Information）：將CAPA結果回饋給管理層和相關部門
blocks.en: Disseminate Information: feed the CAPA results back to management and relevant departments

blocks.zh: 最常見的 FDA 483 觀察項目
blocks.en: The Most Common FDA 483 Observations

blocks.zh: 對組合產品廠商而言，CAPA 相關的 FDA 483 最常見於：
blocks.en: For combination product manufacturers, CAPA-related FDA 483 observations most often concern:

blocks.zh: CAPA 程序缺乏有效性確認步驟（Effectiveness Check）
blocks.en: CAPA procedures lacking an effectiveness check step

blocks.zh: 預防行動（PA）流於形式，與根本原因脫鉤
blocks.en: Preventive actions (PA) that are merely formal and disconnected from the root cause

blocks.zh: 多設施/合約商的 CAPA 資訊未有效整合
blocks.en: CAPA information from multiple sites/contract manufacturers not effectively integrated

blocks.zh: CAPA 資訊未定期回饋管理審查（820.20）
blocks.en: CAPA information not regularly fed back into management review (820.20)

blocks.zh: 比喻：醫院感控 vs. 防火
blocks.en: Analogy: Hospital Infection Control vs. Fire Prevention

blocks.zh: 藥品偏差調查像「醫院感控」——有病人感染了，找出病因，治療它。820.100 CAPA 則加上「防火」功能——不只治療感染，還要找出醫院中所有可能導致感染的潛在風險，在它發生前就修正。
blocks.en: A drug deviation investigation is like "hospital infection control": a patient is infected, so you find the cause and treat it. 820.100 CAPA adds the "fire prevention" function: not only treating the infection, but finding all the potential risks in the hospital that could cause infection and correcting them before they occur.

blocks.zh: 這就是「糾正行動」與「預防行動」的本質差異。
blocks.en: This is the essential difference between "corrective action" and "preventive action".

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務場景：跨廠 CAPA 協調
blocks.en: CDMO Practical Scenario: Cross-Site CAPA Coordination

blocks.zh: 你的CDMO負責充填，器材零件由另一家供應商提供，最終組裝由第三家合約商進行。當市場上發現自動注射器漏液問題時，820.100 要求：
blocks.en: Your CDMO does the filling, the device components come from another supplier, and final assembly is done by a third contract manufacturer. When a leakage problem with the autoinjector is found on the market, 820.100 requires that:

blocks.zh: 你（CDMO）仍對 CAPA 的整體執行和有效性負責
blocks.en: You (the CDMO) remain responsible for the overall execution and effectiveness of the CAPA

blocks.zh: 必須協調三家設施共同進行根因調查
blocks.en: You must coordinate all three facilities in a joint root cause investigation

blocks.zh: CAPA 措施必須覆蓋所有相關的製造步驟
blocks.en: CAPA measures must cover all relevant manufacturing steps

blocks.zh: 建立機制確保合約商的 CAPA 資訊能流回你的 QMS
blocks.en: A mechanism must be established to ensure that the contract manufacturers' CAPA information flows back into your QMS

blocks.zh: 這意味著你的品質協議（Quality Agreement）中，必須明訂 CAPA 資訊分享和協調的義務。
blocks.en: This means your Quality Agreement must specify obligations for CAPA information sharing and coordination.

blocks.zh: 你的CDMO目前有「偏差調查SOP」和「OOS處理SOP」。要滿足 820.100 的要求，你需要新增或修改哪些程序？「Effectiveness Check」具體應如何設計？
blocks.en: Your CDMO currently has a "Deviation Investigation SOP" and an "OOS Handling SOP". What procedures must you add or revise to meet 820.100? How should the "Effectiveness Check" be designed in practice?

blocks.zh: 820.170 & 820.200 — 多數無菌充填CDMO不適用
blocks.en: 820.170 & 820.200: Not Applicable to Most Sterile Filling CDMOs

blocks.zh: 適用性判斷的關鍵問題
blocks.en: Key Questions for Determining Applicability

blocks.zh: 你需要問的第一個問題是：你的組合產品是否需要在終端使用者處安裝或維修保養？
blocks.en: The first question to ask is: does your combination product need to be installed or serviced at the end user's site?

blocks.zh: 如果是單次使用的 PFS、自動注射器、吸入器：通常不適用 820.170 和 820.200。這類產品在使用後即丟棄，不需要安裝或服務。
blocks.en: If it is a single-use PFS, autoinjector or inhaler: 820.170 and 820.200 are generally not applicable. These products are discarded after use and require no installation or servicing.

blocks.zh: 如果是需植入並定期維修的遞藥系統（如植入式胰島素幫浦）：適用。
blocks.en: If it is a drug delivery system that is implanted and serviced periodically (such as an implantable insulin pump): they apply.

blocks.zh: 如果是需在醫院安裝的大型遞藥設備（如靜脈注射泵）：適用。
blocks.en: If it is a large drug delivery device installed in a hospital (such as an IV infusion pump): they apply.

blocks.zh: 如何正式記錄「不適用」的判斷？
blocks.en: How to Formally Document a "Not Applicable" Determination

blocks.zh: 即使你判斷 820.170 和 820.200 不適用，FDA 仍期望你有書面的適用性評估記錄。
blocks.en: Even if you determine that 820.170 and 820.200 do not apply, FDA still expects a written applicability assessment record.

blocks.zh: 建議做法：在品質計畫（Quality Plan）中加入一節「CGMP 適用性評估」，針對每一項 4.4(b)(1) 規定，說明其是否適用及理由。
blocks.en: Recommended approach: add a section on "CGMP Applicability Assessment" to the Quality Plan, stating for each 4.4(b)(1) provision whether it applies and why.

blocks.zh: 這讓稽查員能快速理解你的判斷邏輯，而不是讓他質疑你「忘記」了這兩項要求。
blocks.en: This lets an inspector quickly understand your reasoning, rather than questioning whether you "forgot" these two requirements.

blocks.zh: 比喻：建築法規中的電梯條款
blocks.en: Analogy: The Elevator Clause in Building Codes

blocks.zh: 蓋一間兩層樓的小屋，建築法規中有電梯相關條款，但你評估後判定不需要安裝電梯——你仍需要在建築計畫書中寫明「本建築物層數低於法規強制安裝電梯的標準，故本條款不適用」。
blocks.en: You build a small two-storey house. The building code has elevator provisions, and you assess that no elevator is needed, but you still need to state in the building plan: "This building has fewer storeys than the threshold requiring an elevator, so this clause does not apply."

blocks.zh: 820.170 / 820.200 的處理邏輯相同：明確記錄不適用的原因，而非沉默跳過。
blocks.en: 820.170 / 820.200 are handled the same way: explicitly document why they do not apply, rather than silently skipping them.

blocks.zh: 你的客戶開發了一個重複使用的注射筆（reusable pen injector）搭配藥物卡匣的組合產品。請判斷 820.170 和 820.200 是否適用，並說明你的推理依據。
blocks.en: Your client has developed a combination product consisting of a reusable pen injector with a drug cartridge. Determine whether 820.170 and 820.200 apply, and explain your reasoning.

blocks.zh: QMSR 更新重點：2026年2月生效
blocks.en: QMSR Update Highlights: Effective February 2026

blocks.zh: 這是本節最新的監管動態
blocks.en: This Is the Latest Regulatory Development in This Section

blocks.zh: 本份FDA指引發布於2017年，引用的是舊版 21 CFR Part 820（Quality System Regulation）。但自2026年2月2日起，Part 820 已正式由新的 QMSR（Quality Management System Regulation）取代。
blocks.en: This FDA guidance was issued in 2017 and cites the old 21 CFR Part 820 (Quality System Regulation). But since February 2, 2026, Part 820 has been formally replaced by the new QMSR (Quality Management System Regulation).

blocks.zh: QMSR 的核心改變：直接採納 ISO 13485:2016 的框架與術語，使美國器材法規與國際標準接軌。對於持有 ISO 13485 認證的廠商，合規路徑更為直接。
blocks.en: The core change in the QMSR: it directly adopts the framework and terminology of ISO 13485:2016, aligning US device regulation with the international standard. For manufacturers holding ISO 13485 certification, the compliance path is more direct.

blocks.zh: 對組合產品廠商的實務影響
blocks.en: Practical Impact on Combination Product Manufacturers

blocks.zh: 六項要求的本質不變：4.4(b)(1) 仍引用這六項，只是底層法規文本更新了
blocks.en: The substance of the six requirements is unchanged: 4.4(b)(1) still cites these six; only the underlying regulatory text has been updated

blocks.zh: ISO 13485認證廠可利用協同效應：如果你的器材零件供應商持有 ISO 13485 認證，他們的 QMS 架構現在更直接與你的 QMSR 義務接軌
blocks.en: ISO 13485-certified manufacturers can leverage synergies: if your device component suppliers hold ISO 13485 certification, their QMS structure now aligns more directly with your QMSR obligations

blocks.zh: 術語調和：QMSR 採用 ISO 13485 的術語，有助於與歐盟 MDR/IVDR 的合規活動整合
blocks.en: Harmonized terminology: the QMSR uses ISO 13485 terminology, which helps integrate compliance activities with EU MDR/IVDR

blocks.zh: 設計管控更新：ISO 13485 §7.3 在某些細節上比舊版 820.30 更為詳細，建議逐條核對差異
blocks.en: Design control updates: ISO 13485 §7.3 is more detailed than the old 820.30 in some respects; a clause-by-clause comparison of the differences is recommended

blocks.zh: 比喻：從舊版 Windows 升級到新版
blocks.en: Analogy: Upgrading from an Old Version of Windows to a New One

blocks.zh: QMSR 就像把舊版作業系統升級——核心功能和應用程式（六項要求）還在，但底層架構更現代化、與國際標準更兼容。你現有的「應用程式」（SOP、程序文件）基本可用，但需要確認它們在新系統上能正常執行（符合QMSR條文的新細節要求）。
blocks.en: The QMSR is like upgrading an old operating system: the core functions and applications (the six requirements) are still there, but the underlying architecture is more modern and more compatible with international standards. Your existing "applications" (SOPs, procedural documents) are largely usable, but you need to confirm that they run correctly on the new system (meet the new detailed requirements of the QMSR text).

blocks.zh: 行動建議
blocks.en: Recommended Actions

blocks.zh: 如果你的CDMO正在建立組合產品品質系統：
blocks.en: If your CDMO is building a combination product quality system:

blocks.zh: 直接對照 QMSR（新版 Part 820）和 ISO 13485:2016，而不是2017年指引中引用的舊版條文
blocks.en: Map directly against the QMSR (the new Part 820) and ISO 13485:2016, not the old provisions cited in the 2017 guidance

blocks.zh: 考慮同時取得 ISO 13485 認證，一石二鳥：滿足 QMSR 合規 + 歐盟市場準入
blocks.en: Consider obtaining ISO 13485 certification at the same time, to kill two birds with one stone: QMSR compliance plus EU market access

blocks.zh: 與你的法規事務顧問確認 4.4(b)(1) 引用條文如何映射到 QMSR 的新條文編號
blocks.en: Confirm with your regulatory affairs consultant how the provisions cited in 4.4(b)(1) map to the new QMSR clause numbers

blocks.zh: Section IV.A 六項器材QS規定 — 總覽比較表
blocks.en: Section IV.A: Six Device QS Provisions, Overview Comparison Table

blocks.zh: 綜合思考練習 — Section IV.A 整體應用
blocks.en: Integrated Thinking Exercise: Applying Section IV.A as a Whole

blocks.zh: 你是一家無菌充填CDMO的法規事務主任。客戶要求你協助其開發一個含皮下注射自動注射器（autoinjector）的生物製劑組合產品，採用藥品CGMP基礎的簡化途徑（21 CFR 4.4(b)(1)）。
blocks.en: You are the Director of Regulatory Affairs at a sterile filling CDMO. A client asks you to help develop a biologic combination product containing a subcutaneous autoinjector, using the streamlined drug CGMP-based approach (21 CFR 4.4(b)(1)).

blocks.zh: 請針對以下問題給出你的分析：
blocks.en: Give your analysis of the following questions:

blocks.zh: 820.30：設計管控的起點是何時？你的CDMO作為受託製造商，在設計管控中扮演什麼角色？DHF 應由誰持有？
blocks.en: 820.30: When do design controls begin? What role does your CDMO play in design controls as a contract manufacturer? Who should hold the DHF?

blocks.zh: 820.50：你需要對哪些供應商進行器材QS規定下的採購管控評估？與現有藥品供應商資格系統如何整合？
blocks.en: 820.50: Which suppliers must you assess for purchasing controls under the device QS provisions? How would you integrate this with your existing drug supplier qualification system?

blocks.zh: 820.100：你的現有偏差調查系統需要哪些具體升級，才能符合 820.100 的閉環 CAPA 要求？
blocks.en: 820.100: What specific upgrades does your existing deviation investigation system need to meet the closed-loop CAPA requirements of 820.100?

blocks.zh: 820.170 / 820.200：這兩項對你的自動注射器產品是否適用？請說明判斷邏輯並描述如何記錄你的評估結論。
blocks.en: 820.170 / 820.200: Do these two apply to your autoinjector product? Explain your reasoning and describe how you would document your assessment conclusion.
